map.r²=1.3²+1.2²=3.13；cosθ2=(3.13−2)/(2×1×1): r² = 1.3² + 1.2² = 3.13; cos θ2 = (3.13 - 2)/(2 x 1 x 1) = 0.565, so θ2 ≈ 55.6°, solvable and inside the workspace.
map.r>2m 则无解，目标不可达需重规划。: If r > 2 m there is no solution and the target must be replanned.
